next.setMcpEnabled: Disable the broken server until its command is available.

compensation.rolledBack: The original file was restored automatically.
compensation.refusedExternalChange: The file changed after Nexus wrote it, so it was not rolled back. Review it manually.
compensation.rollbackFailed: Automatic rollback failed. Use the backup listed under Configuration.
backup.encrypted: Encrypted copy of the current file, made before writing
rollback.automaticIfUnchanged: Automatic if verification fails and the file was not edited since
rollback.manual: Manual (package managers cannot be rolled back automatically)
privileges.currentUser: Current user only; no administrator rights
verify.modelApplied: The configuration file selects the model
verify.mcpEnabled: The MCP server state matches the request
verify.mcpPresent: The MCP server is present with the expected origin
verify.mcpAbsent: The MCP server entry is gone
verify.restore: The file matches the backup exactly
verify.installed: A new scan finds the planned version
verify.updated: A new scan finds the planned version
verify.removed: A new scan no longer finds the installation
warning.agentToolsUnavailable: The Agent will no longer load this server's tools.
warning.remoteMcpNetwork: The Agent will connect to this origin and may send it your prompts and tool results.
warning.publisherUnverified: The server's publisher and behaviour are not verified by Nexus.
warning.availabilityUnverified: This model was entered or discovered locally; its availability to your account is not verified.
warning.effectiveOverridden: A higher-priority source (environment or managed settings) will still override this value.
warning.nextSession: Running Agent sessions pick up the model at their next start.
warning.alreadyConfigured: The configuration already selects this model; Nexus will only verify and record it.
warning.restoreReintroducesExecutable: The backup contains executable settings (hooks, MCP commands or helpers) that are not in the current file.
warning.replacesMalformed: The current file is malformed and will be replaced entirely.
warning.restoreReplacesLaterChanges: Changes made after this backup will be replaced. The current file is backed up first.
warning.packageScripts: The package manager may run install scripts from this package.
warning.versionChosenByAgent: The Agent's own updater chooses the version; it cannot be pinned in advance.
warning.uninstallExternal: This installation was not made by Nexus; it is removed with the installer that created it.
deniedHelp: Nothing was changed. The plan was discarded; prepare it again to retry.
errorHelp: Nothing was changed unless the result below says otherwise.
createsFile: The file does not exist yet and will be created.
nativeConfirmHelp: A system dialog shows the same plan. Nothing changes unless you confirm it there.
